follow-up time: 273 days before through 42 days after delivery hospitalization discharge
cohort: 1,952,432 pregnancies covered by commercial insurance from 2009 to 2019 resulting in term, singleton delivery hospitalizations.
finding: Total and out-of-pocket medical costs for maternity care are increasing among commercially insured patients, with chronic hypertension, pregestational diabetes, and cesarean delivery being important predictors of costs.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with increased median total pregnancy costs compared to vaginal delivery.
